# Winning Rules

#### Course: Learn JavaScript Basics

## Winning Rules

1. rock - scissors: rock will win (rock crushes scissors)

![Rock will crush scissors](data:image/png;base64,)

2. rock - paper: paper will win (paper covers rock)

![Paper will cover rock](data:image/png;base64,)

3. scissors - paper: scissors win (scissors cut paper)

![Scissors will cut paper](data:image/png;base64,)

Next, let's see how you can create this game.
